output:
JBMC constructs every bounded row graph from primitive inputs, including null, independent rows and aliases to earlier rows.
note: JBMC runs 3 constructs otherwise than the JVM, whatever its class path:
  jbmc defect: stubbed-handler at PropertyHarness.check: catch (java.lang.Error) catches java.lang.AssertionError on the JVM, which the program may raise, but JBMC has no class file of java.lang.Error and its stub has no superclass, so JBMC does not know the exception's class extends it: the exception escapes the handler

  jbmc defect: stubbed-handler at PropertyHarness.check: catch (java.lang.RuntimeException) catches java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, java.lang.IllegalArgumentException, java.lang.NullPointerException, java.util.NoSuchElementException on the JVM, which the program may raise, but JBMC has no class file of java.lang.RuntimeException and its stub has no superclass, so JBMC does not know their classes extend it: the exception escapes the handler
